text:
BUPATI PROBOLINGGO
MEMUTUSKAN :
Menetapkan : PERATURAN DAERAH TENTANG PENYELENGGARAAN  PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK.
translated_text:
REGENT OF PROBOLINGGO
DECIDES:
To Establish: REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION FOR WOMEN AND CHILDREN.

text:
BAB I
KETENTUAN UMUM
Pasal 1
Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan :
1. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Probolinggo.
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Pemerintah Kabupaten Probolinggo. 3. Bupati adalah Bupati Probolinggo.
4. Dinas adalah Perangkat Daerah yang mempunyai tugas dan fungsi  perlindungan perempuan dan anak.
5. Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu Pemberdayaan Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya  disingkat PPT adalah pusat pelayanan yang terintegrasi dalam upaya  pemberdayaan perempuan di berbagai bidang pembangunan serta perlindungan  perempuan dan anak dari berbagai jenis diskriminasi dan tindak kekerasan,  termasuk perdagangan orang, yang dibentuk oleh Pemerintah Daerah atau  berbasis masyarakat.
6. Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak adalah segala kegiatan untuk melindungi  hak-hak perempuan dan anak serta memberikan rasa aman dalam pemenuhan  hak-haknya tanpa kekerasan dan diskriminasi sesuai harkat dan martabat  kemanusiaan.
7. Perempuan adalah manusia dewasa berjenis kelamin perempuan dan orang  yang oleh hukum diakui sebagai perempuan.
8. Anak adalah seseorang yang belum berusia 18 (delapan belas) tahun atau anak  yang disangka, didakwa yang dijatuhi pidana dan anak yang menjadi korban  tindak pidana.
9. Kekerasan adalah setiap perbuatan yang berakibat timbulnya kesengsaraan  atau penderitaan secara fisik, psikis, seksual, dan/atau penelantaran, termasuk  ancaman untuk melakukan perbuatan, pemaksaan atau perampasan  kemerdekaan secara melawan hukum.
10. Diskriminasi adalah setiap pembedaan, pengucilan atau pembatasan yang  dibuat atas dasar jenis kelamin, suku, agama, rasa, dan warna kulit yang  mempunyai pengaruh atau tujuan untuk mengurangi atau menghapuskan  pengakuan, penikmatan atau penggunaan hak-hak asasi manusia.
11. Korban adalah perempuan dan anak yang mengalami kesengsaraan dan/atau  penderitaan baik secara langsung maupun tidak langsung sebagai akibat  kekerasan.
12. Pelayanan adalah kegiatan dan tindakan segera yang dilakukan oleh tenaga  profesional sesuai dengan profesi masing-masing berupa konseling, terapi dan  advokasi guna penguatan dan pemulihan korban kekerasan.
13. Pendampingan adalah segala tindakan berupa konseling, terapi psikologis,  advokasi, dan bimbingan rohani, guna penguatan diri korban kekerasan untuk  menyelesaikan permasalahan yang dihadapi.
14. Pemulangan adalah upaya pengembalian perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan kepada pihak keluarga, keluarga pengganti, atau masyarakat yang  dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pemenuhan kebutuhannya.
15. Rehabilitasi adalah pemulihan korban dari gangguan psikososial dan  pengembalian keberfungsian sosial secara wajar, baik dalam keluarga maupun  dalam masyarakat.
16. Rumah Aman yang selanjutnya disebut Shelter adalah tempat tinggal sementara  yang digunakan untuk memberikan perlindungan terhadap korban sesuai  dengan standar operasional yang ditentukan.
17. Masyarakat adalah perseorangan, keluarga, kelompok, organisasi sosial  dan/atau organisasi kemasyarakatan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article 1
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Probolinggo Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Government of Probolinggo Regency.
3. Regent is the Regent of Probolinggo.
4. Agency is a Regional Apparatus that has the duties and functions of protection of women and children.
5. Integrated Service Center for Women and Children Empowerment, hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an integrated service center in efforts to empower women in various fields of development as well as protection of women and children from various types of discrimination and acts of violence, including trafficking in persons, which is established by the Regional Government or community-based.
6. Protection of Women and Children is all activities to protect the rights of women and children and provide a sense of security in the fulfillment of their rights without violence and discrimination in accordance with human dignity.
7. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is recognized by law as a woman.
8. Child is a person who has not reached the age of 18 (eighteen) years or a child who is suspected, charged with a criminal offense and a child who is a victim of a criminal offense.
9. Violence is any act that results in misery or suffering physically, psychologically, sexually, and/or neglect, including threats to commit acts, coercion or deprivation of liberty unlawfully.
10. Discrimination is any distinction, exclusion or restriction made on the basis of sex, ethnicity, religion, race, and skin color that has the effect or purpose of reducing or eliminating the recognition, enjoyment or exercise of human rights.
11. Victim is a woman and child who experiences misery and/or suffering either directly or indirectly as a result of violence.
12. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.
13. Assistance is all actions in the form of counseling, psychological therapy, advocacy, and spiritual guidance, for the self-strengthening of victims of violence to resolve the problems they face.
14. Repatriation is an effort to return women and children victims of violence to their families, substitute families, or communities that can provide protection and fulfillment of their needs.
15. Rehabilitation is the recovery of victims from psychosocial disorders and the restoration of normal social functioning, both in the family and in society.
16. Safe House, hereinafter referred to as Shelter, is a temporary residence used to provide protection to victims in accordance with determined operational standards.
17. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

PERENCANAAN
Pasal 6

translated_text:
CHAPTER IV
PLANNING
Article 6
The Regent establishes basic policies for the implementation of protection of women and children in the Region.

text:
Pasal 7
(1) Kebijakan dasar sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 6 dijabarkan dalam  Rencana Aksi Daerah.
(2) Rencana Aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) terintegrasi dengan  dokumen Rencana Pembangunan Jangka Panjang Daerah, Rencana  Pembangunan Jangka Menengah Daerah dan Rencana Kerja Pemerintah  Daerah.
(3) Rencana Aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) sekurang-kurangnya  memuat :
a. program dan kegiatan aksi perlindungan perempuan dan anak, termasuk  perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan;
b. program dan kegiatan aksi daerah untuk mencegah segala bentuk kekerasan  dan diskriminasi terhadap perempuan dan anak;
c. program dan kegiatan aksi perbaikan dan peningkatan pelayanan  perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan; dan
d. program dan kegiatan aksi pemberdayaan perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan.
(4) Ketentuan mengenai Rencana Aksi Daerah sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1)  diatur lebih lanjut dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 7
(1) The basic policy as referred to in Article 6 shall be elaborated in the Regional Action Plan.
(2) The Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be integrated with the Regional Long-Term Development Plan document, Regional Medium-Term Development Plan and Regional Government Work Plan.
(3) The Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (1) shall contain at minimum:
a. action programs and activities for the protection of women and children, including women and children victims of violence;
b. regional action programs and activities to prevent all forms of violence and discrimination against women and children;
c. action programs and activities for the improvement and enhancement of protection services for women and children victims of violence; and
d. action programs and activities for the empowerment of women and children victims of violence.
(4) Provisions regarding the Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be further regulated by Regent Regulation.

text:
Pasal 8
Rencana Aksi Daerah wajib dijadikan sebagai pedoman bagi Pemerintah Daerah  dalam menyusun kebijakan yang terkait dengan penyelenggaraan perlindungan  perempuan dan anak.
translated_text:
Article 8
The Regional Action Plan must be used as a guideline for Regional Governments in formulating policies related to the implementation of protection of women and children.

text:
BAB V
PELAKSANAAN PERLINDUNGAN
Bagian Kesatu
Umum
translated_text:
CHAPTER V
IMPLEMENTATION OF PROTECTION
Part One
General

text:
Pasal 9
(1) Bupati wajib melaksanakan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan perlindungan  perempuan dan anak secara terpadu dalam rangka pemenuhan hak-hak  perempuan dan anak di Dearah.
(2) Dalam pelaksanaan tugas sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1), Dinas  berkoordinasi dengan organisasi perangkat daerah, aparat penegak hukum dan  masyarakat.
translated_text:
Article 9
(1) The Regent is obligated to implement policies, programs and activities for the protection of women and children in an integrated manner in order to fulfill the rights of women and children in the Region.
(2) In carrying out the duties as referred to in paragraph (1), the Service coordinates with regional apparatus organizations, law enforcement officials and the community.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/terminology: "Dinas" should be translated as "Service/Department" (local government office), not "Agency".

Typo in source reflected in meaning: "Dearah" clearly intended "Daerah"; translate as "Region" (already done), but ensure consistency with local-government context by using "in the Region" and correct institutional term.

Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak Korban Kekerasan
translated_text:
Second Part
Protection of Women and Children Victims of Violence

text:
Paragraf 1
Bentuk Kekerasan
translated_text:
Paragraph 1
Forms of Violence

text:
Pasal 11
Kekerasan fisik sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 10 huruf a disebabkan karena  perbuatan yang mengakibatkan rasa sakit, cedera, luka atau cacat pada tubuh  seseorang, gugurnya kandungan, pingsan dan/atau menyebabkan kematian.
translated_text:
Article 11
Physical violence as referred to in Article 10 letter a is caused by acts that result in pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage, loss of consciousness and/or cause death.

text:
Pasal 12
Kekerasan psikis sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 10 huruf b disebabkan  karena perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketakutan, hilangnya rasa percaya diri,  hilangnya kemampuan untuk bertindak, rasa tidak berdaya dan/atau penderitaan  psikis berat pada seseorang.
translated_text:
Article 12
Psychological violence as referred to in Article 10 letter b is caused by acts that result in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, feelings of helplessness and/or severe psychological suffering in a person.
qa_issues: Minor meaning/grammar drift: "severe psychological suffering to a person" is unidiomatic and can imply direction; should be "in a person" to match "pada seseorang".
Scrambled list/numbering structure: item d is merged into item c on the same line, making the list structure unclear.
Meaning drift/formatting: "and or" should be rendered as "and/or" to match "dan atau" in the original. (No change in meaning intended, but current phrasing is incorrect.)

text:
Pasal 14
Penelantaran sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 10 huruf d disebabkan karena :  a. perbuatan yang mengakibatkan tidak terpenuhinya kebutuhan anak secara  wajar, baik fisik, mental, spiritual maupun sosial yang dilakukan oleh orang  tua, wali, atau pihak lain maupun yang bertanggung jawab atas pengasuhan;  b. perbuatan mengabaikan dengan sengaja untuk memelihara, merawat, atau  mengurus anak sebagaimana mestinya yang dilakukan oleh orang tua, wali atau  pihak lain manapun yang bertanggung jawab atas pengasuhannya; c. perbuatan yang menelantarkan orang dalam lingkup rumah tangganya, padahal  menurut hukum yang berlaku baginya atau karena persetujuan atau perjanjian  ia wajib memberikan penghidupan, perawatan, atau pemeliharaan kepada orang  tersebut; dan/atau
d. perbuatan yang mengakibatkan ketergantungan ekonomi dengan cara  membatasi dan/atau melarang untuk bekerja yang layak di dalam atau di luar  rumah sehingga korban berada di bawah kendali orang tersebut.
translated_text:
Article 14
Neglect as referred to in Article 10 letter d is caused by: a. acts that result in the failure to fulfill the needs of a child properly, whether physical, mental, spiritual or social, committed by parents, guardians, or other parties responsible for care; b. acts of deliberately neglecting to maintain, care for, or look after a child as appropriate, committed by parents, guardians or any other party responsible for their care; c. acts of neglecting a person within the scope of their household, whereas according to the law applicable to them or due to an agreement or contract they are obligated to provide livelihood, care, or maintenance to that person; and/or
d. acts that result in economic dependence by means of restricting and/or prohibiting from engaging in decent work inside or outside the home so that the victim is under the control of that person.

text:
Pasal 15
Eksploitasi sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 10 huruf e disebabkan karena:  a. perbuatan yang mengeksploitasi ekonomi atau seksual dengan maksud untuk  menguntungkan diri sendiri atau orang lain;
b. perbuatan yang dengan atau tanpa persetujuan korban yang meliputi tapi tidak  terbatas pada pelacuran, kerja atau pelayanan paksa, perbudakan atau praktek  serupa, penindasan, pemerasan, pemanfaatan fisik, seksual, organ reproduksi,  atau secara melawan hukum memindahkan atau mentransplantasi organ  dan/atau jaringan tubuh atau memanfaatkan tenaga atau kemampuan  seseorang oleh pihak lain untuk mendapatkan keuntungan baik materiil  maupun immateriil; dan/atau
c. segala bentuk pemanfaatan organ seksual atau organ tubuh lain dari korban  untuk mendapatkan keuntungan, termasuk tidak terbatas pada semua kegiatan  pelacuran atau pencabulan.
translated_text:
Article 15
Exploitation as referred to in Article 10 letter e is caused by: a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or capabilities of a person by other parties to obtain benefits either material or immaterial; and/or
c. all forms of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse.

Paragraph 2
Rights of Victims

qa_issues: Meaning drift: "continuous handling" and "handling" are unnatural/misleading renderings of "penanganan" in this legal context; should be "continuous assistance/handling" and "confidential handling" better as "confidential assistance/handling"
Meaning drift: item g missing definite sense of "jaminan atas"; should be "a guarantee of" the related rights

Meaning drift/unnatural rendering: "full utilization" mistranslates "penghormatan dan penggunaan sepenuhnya"; should convey full respect and full enjoyment/use of rights for survival, growth, and development.
Meaning drift: "various stigma" should be "various stigmas" (plural) to match "berbagai stigma".

text:
Pasal 18
(1) Dalam hal perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan membutuhkan penanganan  berkelanjutan, maka perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan berhak untuk  tinggal di rumah aman atau tempat tinggal alternatif.
(2) Penanganan berkelanjutan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) merupakan penanganan pada tahap rehabilitasi, baik yang dilakukan PPT, individu,  lembaga swadaya masyarakat, maupun oleh masyarakat.
translated_text:
Article 18
(1) In the event that women and children victims of violence require continuous handling, then women and children victims of violence have the right to stay in a safe house or alternative residence.
(2) Continuous handling as referred to in paragraph (1) constitutes handling at the rehabilitation stage, whether conducted by PPT, individuals, non-governmental organizations, or by the community.

text:
Pasal 19
(1) Rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 18 ayat (1) memberikan  tempat dan/atau penampungan aman sementara bagi korban kekerasan sampai  dengan hak-haknya dipulihkan.
(2) Penyelenggaraan dan/atau pengelolaan rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan oleh Dinas terkait.
(3) Ketentuan mengenai penyelenggaraan rumah aman sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (2) diatur lebh lanjut dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 19
(1) Safe houses as referred to in Article 18 paragraph (1) provide a temporary safe place and/or shelter for victims of violence until their rights are restored.
(2) The organization and/or management of safe houses as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by the relevant Agency.
(3) Provisions regarding the organization of safe houses as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be further regulated by a Regent Regulation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: 'Peraturan Bupati' should be translated as 'Regent Regulation' or 'Regent's Regulation' and should include the article 'a'/'the' to reflect 'dengan Peraturan Bupati' (by/through a Regent Regulation).

Hak-Hak Saksi dan Pelaku
translated_text:
Paragraph 3
Rights of Witnesses and Perpetrators

text:
Pasal 20
(1) Setiap perempuan dan anak yang menjadi saksi atau pelaku kekerasan berhak  untuk mendapatkan informasi, perlindungan, rehabilitasi, penanganan secara  rahasisa, pendampingan psikologis dan hukum, serta pemenuhan hak-haknya  yang berkaitan dengan statusnya sebagai istri, ibu, anak, anggota keluarga  maupun sebagai anggota masyarakat.
(2) Pemenuhan hak sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan sesuai  dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 20
(1) Every woman and child who becomes a witness or perpetrator of violence has the right to obtain information, protection, rehabilitation, confidential handling, psychological and legal assistance, as well as the fulfillment of their rights related to their status as a wife, mother, child, family member or as a member of society.
(2) The fulfillment of rights as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "pelaku kekerasan" (perpetrator of violence) mistranslated as "victim of violence". Should be "perpetrator" (or "perpetrator/actor") to match the original. बाकी content is fine.

text:
Pasal 21
Perlindungan perempuan dan anak korban kekerasan meliputi:
a. pencegahan;
b. pelayanan; dan
c. pemberdayaan.
translated_text:
Article 21
Protection of women and children victims of violence includes:
a. prevention;
b. services; and
c. empowerment.

qa_issues: Scrambled list/numbering structure: in paragraph (2) the list marker 'a.' is run together with the preceding clause ('with: a.') instead of starting a new list item

text:
Pasal 24
(1) Pemberdayaan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 21 huruf c diselenggarakan  melalui :
a. pelatihan kerja;
b. usaha ekonomis produktif dan kelompok usaha bersama; dan c. bantuan permodalan.
(2) Pelatihan kerja sabagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf a meliputi : a. pelatihan keterampilan;
b. praktek kerja lapangan; dan
c. pemagangan.
(3) Usaha ekonomis produktif dan kelompok usaha bersama sabagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf b meliputi :
a. pelatihan keterampilan wirausaha; dan
b. pendampingan pelaku usaha.
(4) Bantuan permodalan sabagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) huruf c meliputi : a. bantuan sarana dan prasarana; dan
b. fasilitas bantuan modal kerja/usaha.
(5) Pemberdayaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan oleh PPT.
translated_text:
Article 24
(1) Empowerment as referred to in Article 21 letter c shall be implemented through:
a. job training;
b. productive economic enterprises and joint business groups; and
c. capital assistance.
(2) Job training as referred to in paragraph (1) letter a includes:
a. skills training;
b. field work practice; and
c. apprenticeship.
(3) Productive economic enterprises and joint business groups as referred to in paragraph (1) letter b include:
a. entrepreneurial skills training; and
b. business actor mentoring.
(4) Capital assistance as referred to in paragraph (1) letter c includes:
a. facilities and infrastructure assistance; and
b. working/business capital assistance facilities.
(5) Empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by PPT.
qa_issues: Scrambled list structure in paragraph (1): item c is run together with item b on the same line ("and c.") instead of being a separate list item.

text:

Pemulihan Korban, Saksi, dan Pelaku
translated_text:
Part Five
Recovery of Victims, Witnesses, and Perpetrators

text:
Pasal 27
Untuk kepentingan pemulihan, perempuan dan anak korban, saksi dan  pelakukekerasan dapat memperoleh pelayanan dari :
a. Lembaga sosial (kelompok atau institusi yang mempunyai ruang lingkup pada  perempuan dan anak) dan atau;
b. Pekerja sosial (Individu yang mempunyai kopetensi melakukan pemulihan atau  rehabilitasi) yaitu :
1. Perawat
2. Tenaga kesehatan
translated_text:
Article 27
For the purpose of recovery, women and child victims, witnesses and perpetrators of violence may obtain services from:
a. Social institutions (groups or institutions that have a scope in women and children) and/or;
b. Social workers (individuals who have competence to carry out recovery or rehabilitation), namely:
1. Nurses
2. Health personnel
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "tenaga kesehatan" translated as "Health workers"; should be "health personnel" (or "healthcare personnel") to match the original term. Minor but legally relevant term choice.

text:
Pasal 28
(1) Perempuan dan anak korban, saksi dan pelaku kekerasan berhak mendapatkan  pelayanan pemeriksaan kesehatan oleh Faskes sesuai dengan standar  profesinya.
(2) Dalam hal perempuan dan anak korban, saksi, dan pelaku kekerasan  memerlukan perawatan, tenaga kesehatan wajib memberikan layanan  pemulihan dan rehabilitasi kesehatan.
(3) Pemberian layanan pemulihan dan rehabilitasi kesehatan sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (2) dilaksanakan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan  perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 28
(1) Women and children who are victims, witnesses and perpetrators of violence have the right to receive health examination services by Health Facilities in accordance with professional standards.
(2) In the event that women and children who are victims, witnesses, and perpetrators of violence require treatment, health workers are obligated to provide health recovery and rehabilitation services.
(3) The provision of health recovery and rehabilitation services as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 29
(1) Perempuan dan anak Korban, saksi dan pelaku kekerasan berhak mendapatkan  pelayanan konseling dari pekerja sosial, relawan pendamping, dan/atau  pembimbing rohani.
(2) Pekerja sosial, relawan pendamping, dan/atau pembimbing rohani sebagaimana  dimaksud pada ayat (1) wajib memberikan pelayanan kepada perempuan dan  anak korban, saksi dan pelakukekerasan dalam bentuk pemberian konseling  untuk menguatkan, memberikan rasa aman dan rehabilitasi.
translated_text:
Article 29
(1) Women and children who are victims, witnesses, and perpetrators of violence have the right to receive counseling services from social workers, accompanying volunteers, and/or spiritual counselors.
(2) Social workers, accompanying volunteers, and/or spiritual counselors as referred to in paragraph (1) shall provide services to women and children who are victims, witnesses, and perpetrators of violence in the form of counseling to strengthen them, provide a sense of security, and provide rehabilitation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: 'relawan pendamping' translated as 'volunteer companions' (should be 'volunteer assistants/companions' in the sense of accompanying volunteers).

Meaning drift/grammar: 'pelaku kekerasan' rendered as 'perpetrators of violence' but the Indonesian attaches 'kekerasan' to 'pelaku' (perpetrators of violence) consistently; also missing spacing in 'pelakukekerasan' indicates 'pelaku kekerasan'—ensure consistent rendering and parallel structure.
Meaning drift: paragraph (2) 'wajib' is stronger than 'are obligated' in legal drafting; should be 'shall'.

text:
Pasal 33
Dalam menyelenggarakan perlindungan perempuan dan anak, perorangan, lembaga  swadaya masyarakat, lembaga pendidikan, lembaga keagamaan, dan dunia  usahaberkoordinasi dengan PPT.
translated_text:
Article 33
In implementing the protection of women and children, individuals, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, and the business sector shall coordinate with the PPT.

text:
BAB IX
PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN
Pasal 35
(1) Bupati melakukan pembinaan dan pengawasan terhadap penyelenggaraan  perlindungan perempuan dan anak, baik yang dilakukan oleh PPT maupun  lembaga swadaya masyarakat.
(2) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilakukan  dalam rangka mewujudkan tujuan penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan  dan anak sesuai dengan mekanisme dan tata pelayanan yang ditetapkan dalam  peraturan perundang-undangan.
(3) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dilaksanakan  oleh Dinas terkait.
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 35
(1) The Regent conducts guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection of women and children, both carried out by PPT and non-governmental organizations.
(2) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is conducted in order to realize the objectives of implementing protection of women and children in accordance with the mechanisms and service procedures stipulated in laws and regulations.
(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented by the relevant Agency.

text:
Pasal 36
(1) Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 35 dilakukan terhadap: a. pelaksanaan kebijakan, program dan kegiatan perlindungan perempuan dan  anak; dan
b. pemenuhan pedoman dan standar pelayanan minimal dalam pelaksanaan  pencegahan, pelayanan dan pemberdayaan perempuan dan anak korban  kekerasan.
(2) Pengawasan dilakukan setiap berakhirnya tahun anggaran dan hasilnya  digunakan sebagai bahan masukan bagi penyusunan kebijakan, program,  kegiatan perlindungan perempuan dan anak untuk tahun berikutnya.
translated_text:
Article 36
(1) Supervision as referred to in Article 35 is conducted on: a. the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the protection of women and children; and
b. the fulfillment of guidelines and minimum service standards in the implementation of prevention, services and empowerment of women and children victims of violence.
(2) Supervision is conducted at the end of each fiscal year and the results are used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the protection of women and children for the following year.

text:
Pasal 37
Ketentuan mengenai pembinaan dan pengawasan penyelenggaraan perlindungan  perempuan dan anak diatur lebih lanjut dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
Article 37
Provisions regarding the guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection for women and children shall be further regulated by a Regent's Regulation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/unnatural legal term: "Regent Regulation" should be "Regent's Regulation" (Peraturan Bupati).

text:
BAB X
PELAPORAN
Pasal 38
(1) PPT wajib melaporkan pelaksanaan penyelenggaraan perlindungan terhadap  perempuan dan anak kepada Bupati melalui Dinas.
(2) Pelaporan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) disampaikan secara tertulis, meliputi :
a. administrasi;
b. keuangan;
c. pelayanan; dan
d. kinerja.
(3) Penyampaian laporan secara tertulis sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (2),  dilaksanakan paling sedikit 3 (tiga) bulan sekali.
translated_text:
CHAPTER X
REPORTING
Article 38
(1) PPT is obligated to report the implementation of the provision of protection for women and children to the Regent through the Service.
(2) Reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be submitted in writing, covering:
a. administration;
b. finance;
c. services; and
d. performance.
(3) Submission of written reports as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be carried out at least once every 3 (three) months.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "Dinas" should be translated as "Service/Office" (government department), not "Agency".

text:
BAB XI
PENDANAAN
Pasal 39
Dana untuk penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan dan anak bersumber dari: a. Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah;
b. sumber lain yang sah sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang undangan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XI
FUNDING
Article 39
Funds for the implementation of protection of women and children are sourced from: a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget;
b. other lawful sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

text:
Pasal 40
(1) Pemerintah Daerah dapat memberikan bantuan pendanaan kepada organisasi  masyarakat, organisasi sosial, atau lembaga swadaya masyarakat dan  perguruan tinggi yang melaksanakan perlindungan terhadap perempuan dan  anak.
(2) Bantuan pendanaan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) diberikan sesuai  dengan kemampuan keuangan daerah dandilaksanakan sesuai ketentuan  peraturan perundang-undangan.
translated_text:
Article 40
(1) The Regional Government may provide funding assistance to community organizations, social organizations, or non-governmental organizations and universities that implement protection for women and children.
(2) Funding assistance as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be provided in accordance with regional financial capacity and implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: 'Pemerintah Daerah' should be singular ('Regional Government'), not plural ('Regional Governments').
Meaning drift in item (e): Indonesian specifies forcing women/children to have intercourse 'with him' (dengannya), but translation says 'with him/her'.

Minor meaning drift/typo in item (j): Indonesian ends with 'and/or' (dan/atau) indicating continuation; translation keeps it but should not introduce any additional ambiguity; keep as-is but ensure consistency with original phrasing.

text:
Pasal 42
Penyelenggara PPT atau rumah aman dilarang memungut biaya dalam memberikan  pelayanan kepada perempuan dan anak korban, saksi dan pelaku kekerasan.
translated_text:
Article 42
Organizers of PPT or safe houses are prohibited from collecting fees in providing services to women and children who are victims, witnesses and perpetrators of violence.

text:
BAB XIII
SANKSI ADMINISTRATIF
Pasal 43
(1) Tenaga Kesehatan yang menolak atau tidak mau memberikan pelayanan  pemeriksaan kesehatan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 28 dikenakan  sanksi administrasi berupa:
a. peringatan tertulis;
b. pembekuan izin praktek/izin kerja;
c. pembatasan praktek bagi Tenaga Kesehatan yang praktek mandiri; (2) Pekerja sosial, relawan pendamping, dan/atau pembimbing rohani yang  menolak atau tidak mau memberikan pelayanan konseling sebagaimana  dimaksud dalam Pasal 29 dikenakan sanksi administrasi berupa: a. teguran; atau
b. peringatan tertulis.
(3) Ketentuan mengenai mekanisme penjatuhan sanksi sebagaimana dimaksud  pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2) diatur lebih lanjut dengan Peraturan Bupati.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XIII
ADMINISTRATIVE SANCTIONS
Article 43
(1) Health Workers who refuse or are unwilling to provide health examination services as referred to in Article 28 shall be subject to administrative sanctions in the form of:
a. written warning;
b. suspension of practice license/work permit;
c. practice restrictions for Health Workers in independent practice.
(2) Social workers, volunteer companions, and/or spiritual counselors who refuse or are unwilling to provide counseling services as referred to in Article 29 shall be subject to administrative sanctions in the form of:
a. reprimand; or
b. written warning.
(3) Provisions regarding the mechanism for imposing sanctions as referred to in paragraph (1) and paragraph (2) shall be further regulated by a Regent's Regulation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift: 'Peraturan Bupati' should be translated as 'Regent Regulation' (a regulation issued by the Regent), not 'Regent Regulation' is acceptable but should be 'Regent Regulation' consistently; however main issue is terminology: 'pembekuan' means 'freezing'/'revocation/suspension'—here should be 'suspension' is acceptable; no change needed there. Primary required correction: 'Regent Regulation' should be 'Regent's Regulation' to reflect 'Peraturan Bupati'.
Scrambled structure: paragraph (1) list items a–c run into paragraph (2) in the original; ensure clear separation and correct punctuation/formatting.

Meaning drift in item (2)g: missing reference to letter e as the basis for examining identity/documents; current wording implies the documents are those referred to in letter e rather than the authority being as referred to in letter e.
Minor meaning drift in (3): Indonesian uses plural 'Penyidik ... memberitahukan ... menyampaikan hasil penyidikannya' (investigators), but translation uses singular 'The investigator'.

text:
BAB XV
KETENTUAN PIDANA
Pasal 45
(1) Setiap orang yang melanggar larangan sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 41 dan Pasal 42 diancam hukuman pidana paling lama 3 (tiga) bulan kurungan  atau denda paling banyak Rp. 50.000.000,- (lima puluh juta rupiah).
(2) Tindak pidana sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) dan ayat (2) adalah  pelanggaran.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XV
CRIMINAL PROVISIONS
Article 45
(1) Every person who violates the prohibition as referred to in Article 41 and Article 42 shall be subject to a maximum criminal sentence of 3 (three) months imprisonment or a maximum fine of Rp. 50,000,000,- (fifty million rupiah).
(2) The criminal act as referred to in paragraph (1) is a violation.
qa_issues: Meaning drift/internal inconsistency: paragraph (2) incorrectly refers to paragraph (2) again; the original refers to paragraph (1) and paragraph (2), but only paragraph (1) defines the criminal act—this should refer to paragraph (1) (and, if intended, this article) as the basis for classifying it as a violation.

text:
BAB XVI
KETENTUAN PENUTUP
Pasal 46
Peraturan pelaksanaan dari Peraturan Daerah ini harus ditetapkan paling  lama 1 (satu) tahun sejak Peraturan Daerah ini diundangkan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER XVI
CLOSING PROVISIONS
Article 46
The implementing regulations of this Regional Regulation must be established no later than 1 (one) year from the promulgation of this Regional Regulation.

text:
Pasal 32
Peraturan Daerah ini mulai berlaku pada tanggal diundangan.
Agar supaya setiap orang mengetahuinya, memerintahkan pengundangan  peraturan daerah ini dengan penempatannya dalam Lembaran Daerah  Kabupaten Probolinggo.
Ditetapkan di Probolinggo Pada tanggal 1 Maret 2019
translated_text:
Article 32
This Regional Regulation shall come into force on the date of enactment.
In order that everyone may know of it, the promulgation of this regional regulation is ordered by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Probolinggo Regency.
Enacted in Probolinggo On the date of March 1, 2019
qa_issues: Meaning drift: "tanggal diundangan" should be translated as "date of enactment" (date of being promulgated/issued), not "date of promulgation".
Meaning drift: "memerintahkan pengundangan" refers to ordering the promulgation/publication, which should be reflected consistently with the corrected term above.

That the protection of women and children is a mandatory concurrent affair which is the authority, obligation, and responsibility of the Regional Government, therefore regulation is needed as the basis for the implementation of comprehensive and integrated protection of women and children in a Regional Regulation.
